Notes. — The commonest and smallest of the three (not ‘ four large barn-owls’ as stated by Orihuela 2019: 57) Cuban giant barn owls in cave deposits (Arredondo 1984: 22, Suárez & Olson 2015: 542) is currently unknown from tar seep or sinkhole deposits (Suárez 2020 a: 29 – 30).
